items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Buddy Rich during that time, too, and Gene Quill and Phil Woods

ctx.x: But that shouldn't ... should that affect the music?

It didn't affect the music, I mean, you know the personality of the individual musician, but it didn't look right to people, you know. But anyway, Louie made him pay me for the two weeks, enough for the week, and I only played one set. But see, then, Chicago Sound, and working around different people. Oh, I worked with Buddy Rich during that time, too, and Gene Quill and Phil Woods
There was a certain amount of temperament going on. the union
